object_investigated: Elimination of per-child dirty-workspace restoration across one recursion batch by deferring it to a single composed restoration at the node exit.
proposed_method: Exact Gaussian-rational operator algebra at N=8: eager (restore after every child) vs deferred (restore once at exit). Two questions decided exactly: the summed-defect criterion sum_i B_i (G_{i-1}...G_1 - I) = 0 for exact observables (read-free batches are SUFFICIENT, not necessary) and composable restoration family / retained factorization (cost).
parameter_range: N=8 coefficient positions (e=3); r=3 children per node; restoration families: diagonal unit phases (a in {1,2,3} via i^(a*popcount)), cyclic permutations (shifts {1,2,4}), and a heterogeneous mix (phase+Walsh+permutation).
candidates_considered: Coalesce per-child dirty-workspace restoration across a batch (chosen)
Defer compact-control exceptional-address repair charged at every node to the root
Eliminate the Walsh entrance/exit boundary between same-subset children

expected_deliverable: A research note with a complete restoration cost recurrence, a sharp correctness boundary (read-free), a sharp cost boundary (composable family), and an exact stdlib verifier with two positive cases and two negative controls. No new kappa.
expected_finish: same session; verification reserved for the final quarter
result: Scoped research note: a complete restoration cost recurrence plus (corrected) the exact terminal-observation criterion sum_i B_i (G_{i-1}...G_1 - I) = 0 for the observables, with read-free batches as a sufficient, not necessary, condition, and a cost boundary (pass reduction r->1 when the restorations collapse under composition to one cheap pass, with composition charged r*c_desc under the succinct descriptor hypothesis (c_desc = O(1)) and Theta(r*N) for full-length descriptor tables; deferral costs more only when no cheap factorization is retained and the dense product is applied directly). Two positive cases (phase 3->1 passes / 24->8 mults; permutation 3->1 passes), one example where a single reader breaks deferral, one exact nonzero-reader cancellation case (5 reader children, coefficients [1,1,1,-1,1], summed defect exactly zero, restorations 5->1), and the heterogeneous example: composed product dense (64/64 nonzero) yet its retained factorization costs the eager sum 16 mults at N=8 (verified against the dense product on every basis column), against 64 mults for DIRECT dense application. No new kappa; selected frontier and upstream/ unchanged.

corrected_claims: Correctness: read-free is SUFFICIENT, not necessary. The exact terminal-observation criterion is vanishing summed defect sum_i B_i (G_{i-1}...G_1 - I) = 0; nonzero-reader counterexamples: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1199, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1203, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1205. Prefix/adaptive observation requires each prefix defect B_i (P_{i-1} - I) to vanish (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1205).

Cost: matrix density of the composed product is not an application-cost statement. A dense phase/Walsh/permutation product retains its cheap factorization; sequential factor application costs the eager sum (verified 16 = 16 mults at N=8). Deferral costs more only when no cheap factorization is retained and the dense product must be applied directly; the 64 vs 16 numbers at N=8 are kept as a statement about DIRECT dense application only.
post_review_correction.unchanged: The original reader counterexample (one reader can break deferral) and the original heterogeneous direct-dense counts (64 vs 16 at N=8) still run unchanged; only their scope is corrected.

corrected_claims: Cost recurrence: the O(r) descriptor-composition and one-pass terms are charged under an explicit succinct descriptor hypothesis (fixed-size parameter tuples: phase G = diag(omega^(a*chi(x))) with one exponent a and per-node character chi (checker shape chi(x)=popcount(x), q=4); permutation x -> +-x + s (mod N) with one shift s). Composition is r*c_desc with c_desc = O(1) under the hypothesis; the general full-length-descriptor case is recorded at Theta(r*N) to form the composed table, not O(r).

Evidence scope: the N=8 checker (r=3 phase/rotation/heterogeneous, r=2 reader, r=5 cancellation, all composed as exact dense products) establishes exact observables and costs on those instances only; the general r,N recurrence is a priced hypothesis, not a tested identity.
